title: implement broadcast

atoms.evidence: def broadcast(tensor: Tensor, rank: int, world_size: int, src: int = 0): — canonical per-rank function signature
dist.send(tensor, dst=other_rank) on source; dist.recv(received_tensor, src=src) on non-source — the matched send/recv primitive used to implement broadcast

if rank == src: for other_rank in range(world_size): if other_rank != src: dist.send(...) else: ... dist.recv(received_tensor, src=src); tensor.copy_(received_tensor) — the one-rank-sends-to-all pattern
tensor.copy_(received_tensor) — must use copy_ to mutate the caller's tensor in-place rather than rebinding
